title: Pylon — Aft Engine Mount — Conversion of the Shear Tie to the Two-Piece Standard
abstract: Conversion of the one-piece aft engine mount shear tie to the two-piece bolted standard on delivered aircraft, taking about five hours out of every engine change and removing the fairing damage mode.

sections.planning_reason: Engine changes on the type take longer than the planning figure because the one-piece aft mount shear tie cannot be withdrawn past the pylon rib without removing a fairing section that is not on the engine change access route. Line stations record an average of five and a half additional hours per engine change and two operators have reported damage to the fairing edge during reinstallation. With the fleet entering its first wave of engine shop visits the accumulated cost is significant, and the conversion pays for itself in about three engine changes.
sections.description: The one-piece shear tie is replaced by two bolted halves meeting on the pylon rib centre line and joined through a splice plate with a doubled fastener row. The forward cleat is re-drilled to the new pattern and washers are added under each nut on the outboard face. The harness support on the inboard face moves aft to clear the new splice.
sections.accomplishment_summary: Remove the engine or, preferably, accomplish this bulletin during a scheduled engine removal. Open the fan cowl doors and remove the pylon lower access panel in zone 431. Disconnect the harness support and move it to the aft position given in the accomplishment instructions. Remove the one-piece shear tie D5450123089978. Do a detailed visual inspection of the pylon rib land and a dye penetrant inspection of the existing fastener holes. Re-drill the forward cleat CID666183-16 to the new pattern using the drill jig. Install the two shear tie halves and the splice plate D5450121271272 with washers AES161398-12 under each nut, and torque in the sequence given in the accomplishment instructions. Check the clearance to the mount microswitch 152PP and to the position actuator 498PP5. Install the access panel and close the fan cowl doors. Install the engine and do the engine mount load path check. Record the embodiment.
sections.effectivity_note: Applicable to aircraft MSN C00001 through C00398 that are pre modification standard, on both pylons. Aircraft delivered from MSN C00403 onward were built to the two-piece standard. A single-pylon embodiment is permitted and is recorded per pylon.
sections.material_note: Kit K5450-1011-01 is supplied per pylon and contains the two shear tie halves, the splice plate, the fastener set and the washers. Lead time is eighteen weeks. The removed one-piece tie is returned to Aeralis for metallurgical sampling on the first ten embodiments only.

type_data.compliance_time: At the operator's discretion, preferably during a scheduled engine removal.
